subject: Renewal request — upgrade reserved pool from 8→16 GPUs and throughput SLA
messages:
From: Hannah Groves <hannah.groves@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: acme-renewals@acmeanalytics.com
Date: 2027-05-10T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal discussion — looking to double reserved pool (8→16)

Hi Jasmine,

We’re coming up on our renewal in June and want to explore upgrading our reserved pool from 8→16 GPUs for our production inference workloads. Over the last quarter our 8-GPU pool has hit sustained utilization and we expect more traffic after this month’s product launch.

Can you share a renewal quote that reflects:
- Monthly commit for a 16-GPU reserved pool (price & term options)
- Any throughput guarantees / SLOs we can buy (min p99 token latency targets per region)
- Expected activation lead time and any staged activation options (phased 8→16)

We’d also need a one-page ops runbook that covers activation steps and any required IP allowlists. Procurement is looped (procurement@acmeanalytics.com) for contract timelines.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Groves
Head of Platform Engineering
Acme Analytics

Date: 2027-05-10T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — looking to double reserved pool (8→16)

Hi Hannah — thanks for the heads up, we can definitely support a 16-GPU reserved pool and include a throughput SLA.

Quick next steps:
- I’ll run numbers with Ben (pricing) and Marissa (ops/activation), then send a draft amendment and a short ops runbook for your review.
- Could you confirm target go-live date (end of June vs mid-July)? That affects activation lead time.
- Any preference on billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly)?

I’ll aim to get a formal quote + amendment draft to you by EOD Mon (May 17).

Best,
Jasmine Liu

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-05-12T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal — Acme wants 8→16; need pricing + SLA recommendation

Folks, forwarding Acme’s ask. Key asks: price for 16-GPU monthly commit, throughput/p99 latency SLA, activation timeline, ops runbook. Hannah is targeting end-of-June but can be flexible by ~2 weeks. Procurement is on the thread.

My thoughts: we should offer 2 term options — 12 month at standard uplift, 24 month with a deeper discount and prioritized activation. Add an optional burst window for occasional peak traffic (per-minute token burst) rather than overprovisioning always.

Ben — can you send a price SKU and suggested monthly commit for 16 GPUs plus uplift calculation if they keep a 30% burst reserve?
Marissa — ops lead: what’s realistic activation lead time if we pre-stage a few nodes (phased 8→12 →16) and provide a runbook?

Thanks — want to consolidate a single doc we can send to the customer.

Jasmine

Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal — Acme wants 8→16; need pricing + SLA recommendation

Great, ran preliminary numbers. Proposal below (high level):

Option A — 12-month term (fast activation)
- 16-GPU reserved pool monthly commit: $48,000/month
- Includes 10% monthly burst credits (token-level)
- Throughput SLA: p50 < 40ms, p95 < 120ms, p99 < 300ms for single-region routing; multi-region adds a 20% tail buffer
- Activation lead time: 10 business days (phased activation available in 3 stages)

Option B — 24-month term (discounted)
- 16-GPU reserved pool monthly commit: $41,500/month
- Includes 15% monthly burst credits and prioritized scheduling window for capacity
- Throughput SLA: same targets + guaranteed capacity reservation during scheduled launches
- Activation lead time: 7 business days with pre-staging (requires signed amendment and downpayment)

Operational notes:
- We’ll provide an ops activation runbook (.xlsx) and a checklist to submit IP allowlists and VPC peering details.
- If they want per-route token quotas or auto-fallback to hosted variants, we can include in routing policy for an extra $2,000/mo.

If this looks reasonable I’ll draft the amendment language (pricing table + SLA appendix).

—Ben

DocuSign link for the 24-month amendment: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123xyz

Best,
